title: ALOHA SWEET KIZOMBA WEEKENDER Akwaba edition
description:
Join us in Lyon from May 5 to 9, 2027, to write a new story together.
The Aloha Sweet Kizomba Weekender – Akwaba Edition is all about coming together, sharing our passion, celebrating our cultures, and creating meaningful memories.
For five days, dance will be our shared language, smiles our energy, and the people we meet our greatest treasure.
This edition centers on one simple word: Akwaba.
A word that means “Welcome.”
Welcome to those who have been with us for a long time.
Welcome to those discovering us for the first time.
Welcome to everyone who loves dance, sharing, and good vibes.
💛 We can’t wait to welcome you.
5 days | 5 worlds | 1 culture
This is just the beginning
